title.en: Public page search settings and sitemap scope
title.zh: 公开页面搜索设置与网站地图范围

summary.en: The website separates public page addresses and content, excludes application pages from indexing, and limits its sitemap to five public pages.
summary.zh: 官网分别提供公开页面地址与正文，应用页面排除收录，网站地图仅保留五个公开页面。

body.en:
The homepage (`/`), pricing (`/pricing`), and about page (`/about`) each provide their own canonical address, title, and corresponding readable content.

Application pages, including the character workspace (`/influencer`), use `noindex` and are excluded from the website sitemap. The sitemap contains only `/`, `/pricing`, `/about`, `/privacy`, and `/terms`.

These page settings do not establish that Google has indexed the pages, selected their canonical addresses, or changed brand-name corrections.
body.zh:
首页（`/`）、价格页（`/pricing`）和关于页（`/about`）分别提供自己的正式地址、标题和对应的可读正文。

角色工作台（`/influencer`）等应用页面设置 `noindex`，不进入网站地图。地图仅包含 `/`、`/pricing`、`/about`、`/privacy` 和 `/terms`。

这些页面设置不代表谷歌已经收录页面、采用其正式地址，或改变品牌名称纠错。
